purpose: Progressive-disclosure manifest for one governed Freedom 250 research package.
title: Office of Religious Affairs — 2026
question: How is the Office of Religious Affairs being established, staffed, funded and granted authority, and what do its policies, programs and observed religious-liberty effects show over time?
bluf: A Secretary-level Principal Staff Assistant office with direct access without intervening authority, policy-issuance and resource-advocacy duties, AFCB control, and concrete 60- and 90-day budget, charter, staffing and service-requirements clocks. Establishment and directed planning remain separate from completed transfers, funding, delivery and constitutional results.
evidence_cutoff_note: The two-page signed September 30, 2026 memorandum is preserved and visually verified. It establishes ORA and the Director position effective immediately and directs 60- and 90-day work. No named Director, completed transfer, submitted budget plan, issued charter, assigned staff, service requirements report, funded program or operating result was public by the cutoff. The calculated November 29 and December 29 dates are interval calculations, not dates printed in the memorandum.
use_note: Start with the hub router and signed-memorandum authority map, then use the event ledger for state changes and the source watchboard for exact return triggers. Keep establishment, Director appointment, transfer of duties/authorities/funding, budget plan, charter, billets, service requirements, accepted priority, appropriation or transfer, program rule, delivery and observed religious-liberty result separate.
entities: Under Secretary of War Comptroller Chief Financial Officer

availability_semantics.public_reading: The public site contains both the original public view and a crawler-friendly static HTML reading edition. public_full_text is true.
availability_semantics.public_machine_data: The public site contains the complete positively selected structured dataset. public_full_text is true; reading_url and data_url identify the canonical JSON object.
availability_semantics.private_library_metadata: The governed private Research Library contains the material, but the public site exposes only safe title, role and state metadata. public_full_text is false and access_state is private_by_design. Do not infer its contents.

retrieval_instructions: Open full_text_url for the package before treating a summary as the underlying research.
For a public reading, prefer reading_url. For public_machine_data, open data_url and preserve its schema_version, data_as_of, scope_boundary and evidence vocabulary.
A failure to retrieve public_full_text is an access or crawler problem, not a private-by-design signal.
For access_state private_by_design, use metadata only and do not infer contents.
Preserve the package evidence cutoff, evidence_cutoff_note and any material-specific as_of date. Verify time-sensitive claims with fresh primary sources.
Keep fact, project inference, strongest rival, unresolved object and falsifier separate.
